title: Chapter 390 Aftermath Of The War
content:
Chapter 390 Aftermath Of The War

With the fall of the battle in Guide City, January has passed, and the influence of the war is slowly spreading.

First of all, with the fall of Qin Ming, Governor of Dongjiang Province, the entire Guide Mansion, especially at the moment when he blew himself up, took away all the elites of Dongjiang Province, half of the city was destroyed, and completely lost any resistance. .

Immediately afterwards, the Huangshan demon king, who was recovering from his wounds, took advantage of the fame of this war to call on all the demons in the entire Ming Dynasty to gather under his command and accomplish a great cause.

In just half a month, all the monsters in Dongjiang Province gathered in Guide Mansion, and even the monsters in several neighboring provinces of Dongjiang Province also rushed over.

These demons were all organized and trained by the Demon King of Huangshan Mountain, forming an army of tens of thousands, and practiced near Guide Mansion.

This time the army is quite strong, all of them have the strength of the third rank or above, and many of the fourth ranks are much stronger than the army of the Huangshan Demon King before.

After all, it is a monster that can wreak havoc in the territory of Ming Dynasty. It can survive the encirclement and suppression of the army by the masters of various factions to subdue demons and eliminate demons.

By the way, the training of this group of demons also included attacking the remaining county towns of Guide Mansion, including the dilapidated Guide Mansion City, and two or three surviving county towns in the rear.

Fortunately, Hecheng County, which was at the rear and in the most dangerous situation, avoided the catastrophe again and was ignored by those demons.

It is estimated that the rabbit does not eat the grass beside the nest, and plans to leave this small county town to enjoy it slowly in the future.

In just ten days, the newly trained army under the Demon King of Huangshan swept across the entire Guide Mansion except Hecheng County, and directed their troops at several other surrounding state capitals.

Although the strength of other state capitals is relatively well preserved, they can't stop the army of the Demon King of Huangshan personally sitting in the town, not to mention the Heifeng Lord who saved his life by his side.

This Heifeng Lord is a black tiger who attained the Dao. After 500 years of practice, he reached the realm of the Demon King. He is considered to be the strongest group among all the Demon Kings, much stronger than the Huangshan Demon King.

This time, the Huangshan Demon King's big move is not only quite eye-catching for the entire human world, but even the demon world should stir up troubles, and Lord Heifeng followed, ready to check.

While watching the battle from the sidelines, seeing the Huangshan Demon King in a desperate situation, he rescued him.

But after all, it was a self-destruction of a sixth-order powerhouse. Even if they escaped in time, they were still injured a lot by the aftermath. Everyone had some serious injuries and needed a period of recuperation.

In this way, under the leadership of two sixth-rank demon kings, tens of thousands of demon soldiers were invincible all the way, and all the cities along the way were destroyed. I don't know how many people died at the mouth of these demons.

The situation is urgent. In addition to the fall of Guide Mansion, Dongjiang Province has four other state capitals that have fallen into war, and most of the area has been captured. More than 2/3 of the land has been lost in the blink of an eye. Only two state capitals in the whole province survived. Difficult, but also precarious.

The remaining governor of Dongjiang Province, Zhang An, urgently asked the imperial court for help, hoping that the imperial court would send reinforcements to rescue the scene.

But the result he got made him feel desperate.

A big country located in the north of the Ming Dynasty. The Jin Dynasty sent 300,000 troops to invade the northern border of the Ming Dynasty in the south. Now two or three border provinces have been fighting along the lines, and a lot of territory has been lost. Now the imperial army is sent there to deal with the war , There is no way to deploy troops to support.

However, the situation in Dongjiang Province has also received the attention of the imperial court. Although it is said that soldiers and horses can no longer be dispatched, the masters are all guarding against the Jin Dynasty, and the rest will also sit in the capital and guard against the prying eyes of other countries.

But the three provinces around Dongjiang Province still have enough power.

The Ming Dynasty had 17 provinces, and since the daimyo was surrounded by three great powers, there were many frontier provinces, a total of 11.

However, including Dongjiang Province, these six provinces are inland, and there are no other worries about foreign aggression.

Each of these six inland provinces has a sixth-level governor sitting in town, and there are enough soldiers and horses stationed in the province, and three of them are close to Dongjiang Province.

Today's monsters seem to be powerful, and as time goes by, there are constantly monsters from the Ming Dynasty rushing to join them, making the monster soldiers under the demon king of Huangshan even stronger.

Now, in just one month, more than half of the monsters in the Ming Dynasty rushed to meet up, and the army under the Yellow Mountain Demon King had once again expanded to 30,000, with a huge momentum.

But such strength really made Da Mingchao serious, but it was not enough.

The order of the imperial court came down, and half of the garrisons of the three inland provinces around Dongjiang Province were transferred to form a third-tier army of about 60,000 people, stationed in the three state capitals next to Dongjiang Province and the three provinces.

Firmly trap those monsters within the scope of Dongjiang Province, and cannot expand to other provinces.

And the three sixth-level governors of the three provinces also rushed to the three state capitals to sit in town, in order to deter the two sixth-level demon kings, so that they would not dare to act rashly.

Next, the demon soldiers under the command of the demon king and the Ming army fought each other.

At the moment when the high-level combat forces are restraining each other and dare not act rashly, the outcome of the bottom-level battle becomes particularly important.

The battle results of these bottom-level troops will determine the ownership of the entire Dongjiang Province and cannot be ignored.

Under such circumstances, the Huangshan Demon King urgently summoned the demons in the Ming Dynasty. Within two months, more than 90% of the demons in the Ming Dynasty who could not bear it all rushed to Dongjiang Province to participate in such an event. feast.

Together with the previous batch, these monsters have a number of about 70,000, and the wisdom of the monsters is much nobler than that brought out by the Huangshan Demon King from the forest, and their strength is also stronger.

Facing the 60,000 regular army of the imperial court opposite, they did not lose the wind. You came and I fought, and it was very impressive.

Just like that, a war between monsters and monsters that affected the hearts and minds of the entire Ming Dynasty, and even caring people everywhere in the world, started like this.

After March, the war in Dongjiang Province is still going on, but compared to the beginning, it is much smaller in scale and intensity.

The main reason is that both sides have lost too much. The court only has about 20,000 troops left, and the monsters have 30,000 left.

At this point, the two parties are also hurting their muscles and bones. Whether it is the court or the demon side, there is a tendency to negotiate peace.

Even the peace talks teams of both sides are ready to start preliminary negotiations.

The general agreement is to divide the areas under their respective control now. The state capital courts controlled by the four Huangshan demon kings in the east of Dongjiang Province recognize his right to rule, and the remaining three Huangshan demon kings are not allowed to invade. Make a peace treaty.

This agreement was carried out very quickly, especially when the Ming Dynasty fell into a disadvantage in the northern war and was about to mobilize the internal army to support it, it was extremely hasty.

On the other hand, after the monsters that can be controlled in the entire Ming Dynasty were transferred to Dongjiang Province, most of them were consumed by the war. Even if they knew that now was a good opportunity to capture a larger territory, they could only agree to such a situation when they did not have enough power. contract.

Ever since, a contract that was quite humiliating to the human race was born. In order to commemorate this contract, it was named after the Guide Mansion, the outbreak point of this war, and it was called "Guide Contract between Two Races of Humans and Monsters".
